explanation: Only fires at D1, early in the episode (about trials 5-25), when the agent has been choosing a1 and the last two or more trials were unrewarded: usually about 10 on the second loss in a row (sometimes the third), and only 1-6 at D1 after a first loss that came right after a reward. Every GO and D2 step is 0, as is every D1 after a reward, any D1 while the agent is choosing a2, and almost everything after trial 25, even after a run of losses.
